summary: Build a practical multi-cloud FinOps operating model, dashboards, and optimisation plan. Develop cost control skills through hands-on training.
lede: Cloud FinOps training helps finance and technology professionals make variable cloud spending visible, accountable, and manageable. Participants practise allocating and normalising billing data, forecasting costs, calculating unit economics, and prioritising rightsizing and commitment decisions. They also develop governance routines and dashboard requirements to report spend, variance, and optimisation progress to decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who influence cloud consumption, technology budgets, financial controls, or executive decisions about cloud investment. It suits mixed IT and finance cohorts because Cloud FinOps requires shared accountability rather than isolated reporting.
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to cloud services, technology budgeting, financial reporting, or IT operations. Familiarity with at least one cloud billing statement or usage report will help, but you do not need prior FinOps certification or programming experience. Coding is not required for completion. Advanced topics such as FOCUS data normalization, policy automation, and AI-assisted anomaly detection receive operational application and conceptual treatment rather than production engineering depth. Bring representative, anonymized cost categories or billing challenges if available.
